description: KLR tranche 2 — Composite-3 (Type-B folded crystal) preflight RUN, third in the cont. 9 menu preflight series after Composite-4 (magnitude refutation) and Composite-1 standard (sign refutation). Tests [u²]F for the cont. 9 Option D ansatz F(u) = Σ_T q^{c(T)}·u^{|T|} at sl_4 → C_2 folding, ω_2. σ-fixed 2-subsets at |T|=2 are {1,4} and {2,3} (the only fixed pairs under σ = 1↔4, 2↔3). [u²]F = q^3 + q^3 = 2q^3 > 0 at q > 0, sign-incompatible with c_2 = -1 < 0. cont. 9 Option D (12-17 sessions) NOT authorised. CLAUDE.md §7b bar-invariance of folded crystals does NOT rescue (bar-invariance and sign-negativity are orthogonal).

data.interpretation: Same structural refutation pattern as Composite 1 standard: positivity of q-monomial sums at q > 0 is convention-robust. Folded crystals (CLAUDE.md §7b) inherit positivity from the unfolded sl_n crystal — the σ-fixed subset is a SUBSET of positive basis elements, so its q-weight sum is bounded above by the full sum but still positive. The Composite-3 ansatz has NO q-Pochhammer factor to flip the sign at u², so the refutation is even cleaner than Composite 1 (which had (q;q)_2 > 0 at q > 1 happening to compound the positivity). Combined three-preflight outcome (B + C + D refuted at u^2; A is the only surviving cont. 9 menu option not requiring a separate Demazure-Lusztig preflight scope): ~22-30 sessions of Lean + pyhecke infra build avoided. CAL-3-anchored permanent acceptance is now backed by 3 corpus closures + 3 preflight refutations.
